prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [141].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 141 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: be used on either size, provided we keep both hooks on each cart
options.zh: 用於兩種尺寸，但每臺推車都要保留兩個掛鉤
options.whyZh: 小推車要取下一個掛鉤才有空間，因此不能兩種車都加裝又保留所有掛鉤。

options.text: be used only on smaller carts, where replacing a hook saves room on top
options.zh: 只用於小推車，因為取代一個掛鉤就能省下上層空間
options.whyZh: 小推車改裝雖然能多放袋子，卻會失去其中一瓶的掛放位置，無法維持原本瓶數。

options.text: be used on larger carts even if one of their hooks is removed
options.zh: 用於大推車，即使拿掉其中一個掛鉤也可以
options.whyZh: 拿掉一個掛鉤，仍會讓其中一瓶無處可掛；車大也不會改變這點。

options.text: be used on larger carts while their two hooks stay in place
options.zh: 用於大推車，同時保留原本的兩個掛鉤
options.whyZh: 大推車的掛鉤旁還有空間放收納袋，因此不用移除掛鉤，也仍可攜帶兩瓶。

explanationZh: 大推車的掛鉤旁還有空間放收納袋，因此不用移除掛鉤，也仍可攜帶兩瓶。
evidence: A sleeve fits beside the two hooks on a large cart but needs the space occupied by one hook on a small cart. / the only places for them are the hooks, which hold one bottle apiece. / Without changing how many bottles we carry

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A sleeve fits beside the two hooks on a large cart but needs the space occupied by one hook on a small cart.
the only places for them are the hooks, which hold one bottle apiece.
Without changing how many bottles we carry

vocabulary.note: one bottle apiece 指每個掛鉤各放一瓶，不能把兩瓶都掛在同一個掛鉤。
